title: Nidhögg

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Nidhögg is the sixth one-handed sword. Like other swords it has:
• Primary attack is a 3-hit combo with double damage on the last hit. No damage penalty against multiple targets.
• Secondary attack deals 3x damage with a slightly longer reach.
Like most Ashlands-tier weapons, the Nidhögg can be upgraded to one of the following three variants using gemstones:
• Nidhögg the Bleeding (Bloodstone)
• Nidhögg the Thundering (Iolite)
• Nidhögg the Primal (Jade)
An upgraded Nidhögg will NOT keep its upgrade level when it is modified using gemstones.
